messages:
Ava (Finance): Quick FYI: execs approved interim Q3 budget guidance effective immediately. Main points: a soft hiring freeze for IC roles (except critical product/infra), hiring for customer-facing revenue roles is OK with Sales/Revenue lead signoff, contractors < $8k per month can be onboarded with manager+finance okay, and any vendor or contractor spend > $25k total requires VP finance signoff. Please read the short FAQ linked below.

Tom (Eng): Does "critical product/infra" have a formal exemption process?

Ava (Finance): Yes 1: submit the Hiring Exemption form, include impact statement and timelines, get manager + Eng Director signoff; Finance will route to CFO for final approval if it affects headcount planning. Expect 2 business days for decisions.

Rhea (Hiring): For candidates already in offer stage, do we pause?

Ava (Finance): Offers extended before today remain valid. For open reqs in screening stage, pause new offers until exemption approval. Recruiting ops will flag affected reqs and help managers submit exemptions.

Tom (Eng): How about contractor renewals we already budgeted for?

Ava (Finance): Renewals documented in current quarter budget are allowed. New contractor engagements over $8k/mo need manager+finance approval; multi-month engagements > $25k total need VP finance signoff.

budget-bot: Reminder: submit Hiring Exemption form here: https://intranet.redwood/finance/hire-exempt. See Q&A doc: https://intranet.redwood/finance/q3-guidance :spiral_calendar:

Rhea (Hiring): Can we get a one-pager for managers summarizing the steps? We're creating a template for exemption requests.

Ava (Finance): Yes 1 I'll publish a manager checklist and a short Slack template for requests by tomorrow. If you have urgent cases, email finance@redwood.com with "URGENT EXEMPT" in the subject.

Tom (Eng): Thanks. Small ask: will this affect onboarding budgets for equipment?

Ava (Finance): Onboarding equipment within standard workstation budgets unaffected. Any capital requests outside the standard kit should go through Procurement and follow PO rules.

Ava (Finance): Closing note: these are temporary measures to align spend with updated forecasts. We'll reassess mid-Q3 and communicate changes. Ping finance@redwood.com with questions. :wave:
